name: Perfect Partner
source:
What if the person you met at the nightclub shows up in front of you at work the next day? John Keith is the one man who could satisfy your chronic insensitivity! And this sexy man wants to spend not only his nights with you, but his days as well as your secretary! Will you accept John's offer?

[From in-app]

如果在夜店遇见的那个人，第二天突然出现在工作场所，你会怎么办？只有约翰·基思能够让长期性冷感的你得到满足！而这个性感的男人还想以秘书的身份陪你度过白天与黑夜。你会接受约翰的提议吗？
